item.title: The Trillion-Dollar Bright Spot in China’s Economy: Tourism
item.description: Tens of millions of foreigners visit each year and domestic travel is rising, but some visitors are tightfisted.

item.title: Belgium’s Arrest of Alleged Chinese Chip-Tech Thief Fuels European Fear of Beijing
item.description: Prosecutors suspect the man, detained while leaving for Beijing in May, was siphoning secrets to a Chinese company.

item.title: Chinese Company Draws Fire for Laying Off 100 Grads a Month After Hiring Them
item.description: The major auto parts maker landed in hot water with authorities as young people in the country face a bleak job market.

item.title: China’s Foreign Exchange Reserves Continue to Climb
item.description: China’s foreign-exchange reserves edged higher in August against the backdrop of a weaker dollar and a surging trade surplus, renewing concerns about the yuan’s appreciation.

item.title: At Taiwan’s Temples, a Glimpse of What China Could Have Been
item.description: Decades of separation have produced two very different religious lives on either side of the Taiwan Strait. In Taipei’s crowded temples, a Chinese-born reporter witnesses what was lost.

item.title: Himalayan Disaster Tests China’s Clout as Regional Leader
item.description: China has spent years building a relationship with Nepal. Now Beijing is under pressure to show its embrace can help its neighbor, too.

item.title: U.S. Says It’s Fed Up With China’s Overcapacity—and More Countries Agree
item.description: A G-20 statement implicitly criticizing Beijing for its overreliance on exports for growth marks a new stage in international pressure.

item.title: A Food Crawl in Taiwan Finds Chinese Tradition Without the Spectacle
item.description: Plus, China rejects claims it could have warned Nepal earlier of deadly floods and how China weathered the Iran oil shock, in charts.

item.title: As China Encroaches, Even New Zealand Is Getting Serious About Its Military
item.description: Billions will be spent in the coming years—including on missiles, drones and base upgrades—as the remote country squares up to a widening threat.

item.title: The U.S. Navy’s New Insurance Policy for War With China Is an Australian Base
item.description: The Pentagon plans to deploy submarines to an expanding facility in allies’ strategy to deter Beijing.

item.title: China Rebuts Claims It Could Have Given Nepal Warning of Deadly Floods
item.description: More than 3,000 are missing after a massive flood hit northern Nepal and China’s Tibetan areas.
